why: Lint cycle 1 (docs/v3/cycles/lint-1.md): the class `wiring` P2s and P3s of the weakened-config check. Its seeded offender is written at the top of each declared root only, so an `ignorePatterns: ["src/features/**"]` or a nested `src/features/.oxlintrc.json` holding `{}` turned the guard off for that subtree and doctor reported nothing (lint-1.22). Narrowing a manifest root from `src` to one file passed doctor too (lint-1.23). Check 1 spawns a bare `oxlint` through `Bun.spawn`: run under node it fails with `Bun is not defined`, and run by its bin path with no node_modules/.bin on PATH it fails with `Executable not found in $PATH: "oxlint"`, while basalt-ui lint resolves the project's binary itself; both failures blame a dropped extends (lint-1.24, P3). A root narrowed to a file makes check 1 crash with EFAULT writing the seed into the file path (lint-1.23). check-theme on an app that ran `basalt-ui init` says the package has no basalt key and to run init (lint-1.25, P3; the verb is deleted by v3-teardown-runtime, so that row owns it).
what: The weakened-config check catches a guard that is off for a subtree, and its seeded check runs under the runtimes the CLI supports.
owns: packages/basalt-ui/src/cli/doctor/manifest checks, only for the root-narrowing case
change: Check 1 seeds one offender in every directory under a declared root that holds a source file (or, cheaper, asks oxlint which source files it would lint with `--print-config`/a dry run and compares that set against the files basalt-ui lint scans); any source file the consumer config does not lint is a failure naming the file and the config that dropped it (ignorePatterns, .oxlintignore or a nested .oxlintrc.json). Check 3 also reports a nested `.oxlintrc.json` under a declared root that does not extend the preset. A manifest root that is a file, or a root the git tree shows narrowed against the base ref, is reported by the manifest check. The default runner spawns through node:child_process with the binary `basalt-ui lint` resolves (engine.ts findBin), so it runs under node and bun and without node_modules/.bin on PATH. Tests for each case.
commits: fix: one or two commits in packages/basalt-ui.
proof: Unit tests; the probe script of the cycle (cases W4, W6 and W13 in docs/v3/cycles/lint-1.md) re-run in a scratch app, each now failing doctor.
acceptance: ignorePatterns on a subdirectory of a root fails doctor (test)
A nested .oxlintrc.json without the preset under a root fails doctor (test)
doctor's seeded check passes under node on a clean scratch app
out_of_scope: Blanket file disables (v3-lint-1-blanket-disable); check-theme's message (v3-teardown-runtime deletes the verb).
